provenance.method: For every completed 'Run one closed contract shard' step, the 30 s core-memory sampler prints `ps -eo pid,rss,etime,args --sort=-rss | head -n 6`; each line naming `node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/<file>.test.mjs` was attributed to that file. A measured row's minutes is the maximum etime seen for the file (etimeSeconds, rounded up to at least 0.01 min) and peakRssGb its maximum RSS; it is a lower bound of the file's wall time within one sampling interval. The flattened TAP names tests, not files, so files that completed inside one sampling interval were never observed; they are not measurements and carry defaultMinutes with measured=false and basis unobserved-under-sampling-interval. Shard 4 had no completed hosted run at this head (runner lost) and its files carry defaultMinutes with measured=false and basis unobserved-shard-4-no-completed-run. Split rows: when tests/component-refinement-mirrors.test.mjs stopped executing three former entrypoints, each new root received the sum of the shard-3 TAP durations (job 129026259176, same run) of the tests reachable from its entrypoint (tap-duration-attributed, tapTests counts them), and the umbrella kept its sampler maximum less the attributed minutes (sampler-max-etime-less-attributed), so the four rows still sum to the one measured 267.47 min. previousContract records the closed set these rows extend.

# The measured-cost planner balances all twelve shards to the same
      # critical path. Run the complete matrix together so a second wave
      # cannot double the hosted wall time while runners sit available.
      max-parallel: 12

* Shards are balanced by measured cost. Every contract file carries a cost in
 * scripts/core-contract-costs.json, whose provenance names the exact hosted
 * run, jobs and extraction method, and a longest-processing-time assignment
 * places each file, heaviest first, into the least-loaded shard. A path
 * missing from the manifest, or a manifest path outside the profile, fails
 * closed instead of receiving a silent default.
 *

/**
 * Plan every shard of the complete contract profile from recorded costs.
 *
 * @param paths - Every sorted Core contract test path.
 * @param manifest - Cost manifest; the committed one by default.
 */
export const coreContractShardPlan = (paths, manifest = coreContractCostManifest) =>
	planCostBalancedShards(coreContractCosts(paths, manifest), coreContractShardCount);
